summary: NewBook engine re-read with one-night quotes: base $41 (May 2027) to $60, $48 the only online type in Nov-Dec; 50A/water/sewer and pull-throughs confirmed; old $31.14 was a 7-night 'from' average. Gates and long-stay tests pass; lakeview stands; pin is 850 m off on the access road.
flags: FEES change: the stored $31.14 'From' figure was the engine's default 7-night window average (November 7-14 view shows 'From $30.14'); a single night is $41-60 (May 2027 weeknight) and $48 in Nov-Dec. The prior fees/booking provenance (2026-10-19) carried no method, so this re-read of the same engine replaces it.

Private gates pass: price $41-48 one night (under $50); presence via Google 4.5 (524) + (660) 438-2280 and the NewBook engine; RV Life 5 (8), $$, avg $35. Nothing under 4.0. No gateway needed; family has not stayed.

Long-stay tests (note says many seasonal; an RV Life 9/2026 reviewer titled it 'Marina with a campground for seasonal stays'): (1) $41 May weeknight / $48 winter - pass; (2) the engine sells a single night with no approval - pass; (3) only a 2-night minimum on the lakefront type - pass; (4) 2027-05-11 one night: 38 RV sites open to a 23-ft rig across seven types (of ~100) - pass; 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-08: only the upper-camp 30/50 type sells online (1 site counted on 11-17), the rest say call - winter only; (5) an RV park of herringbone pad loops plus a packed lot east (likely the seasonals) - pass.

WEBSITE field holds two lines (NewBook URL + Facebook). Suggest just https://bookingsus.newbook.cloud/online/sterett_creek (Facebook is not a website). Never use sterettcreek.com: it is now a rifle-sales spam blog.
PHONE missing on the entry: (660) 438-2280 (Google Maps; the engine says 'contact our friendly staff on 6604382280').

Waterfront 'lakeview' stands (re-audited because the operator sells 'Lakefront Back In' sites and reviewers say 'right on the lake'): the only shore pads are a row of 6 back-ins at ~38.2974,-93.3720 whose rears face a gravel loop road; between them and the water are that road and a 15-25 m eroded bank, ~25-35 m in all - a road strip is a buffer under the open-apron rule, so lakeview, not lakefront. The main loops sit 100-250 m up the slope with open views (DEM 224-234 m vs ~213 m at the shore).
PIN MOVE: stored 38.2959,-93.3596 is on the access road ~850 m east of the campground. Move to the pad loops' centroid 38.2982,-93.3700 (Google's pin 38.29560,-93.36860 is the marina store/lot).
